responsibility: Implements logical_location subclasses that translate GCC tree declarations into SARIF-style logical locations. It derives short, scoped, and internal names from lang_hooks and DECL_ASSEMBLER_NAME, classifies declarations by kind such as function/parameter/variable, and provides both a location tied to a specific decl and one reflecting current_function_decl for diagnostic metadata generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the tree-aware logical_location methods that derive SARIF names and kinds from GCC declarations and current_function_decl. Unlike gcc/tree-logical-location.h, this file provides the actual naming/classification behavior.
